title: One fact and a sparse profile still give three or more choices, with no invented facts

rubric: ask is null and there are at least 3 choices, one per key. Every option and trade-off rests only on what the input states: a tailoring business in Nashik serving men and women. Nothing invents a price, a year, a number of customers, a specialty, a channel the brand already uses, a team size or a result.
